subject: Re: Payment cadence & contingent credit trigger for Q3 pilot
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@novahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T09:14:00Z
Subject: Q3 pilot — payment cadence & VAT evidence

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We loved the latency numbers. Before we kick off the pilot in July, procurement needs clarity on two things so we can get PO + payment terms in place:

1) Can Redwood stagger invoices across the pilot milestones (two tranches) rather than a single upfront invoice?
2) Because we're an EU subsidiary, our finance team will require an explicit VAT pass-through plan and a certificate to reconcile payments.

Additionally, CFO (Luca) has asked whether there is a short-term credit buffer we can use during the initial 30 days if usage spikes — we prefer a capped contingency instead of increasing credit limits for the whole account.

Can you send a proposed payment schedule and explain how the contingent buffer would work operationally (who authorizes consumption beyond cap, and what triggers an increase)?

Best,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Data Platforms, NovaHealth
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@novahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-06-08T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Q3 pilot — payment cadence & VAT evidence

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear list. Proposed approach below; happy to adjust.

Proposed payment cadence (two-tranche, milestone-linked):
- Invoice 1 (50%) issued on contract signature — covers environment provisioning, baseline reserved capacity, and initial onboarding support. Net30.
- Invoice 2 (50%) issued upon completion of pilot acceptance tests (sustained SLA for 72 hours & acceptance checklist). Net30.

Contingent credit buffer (short-term cap):
- We can enable a 25% consumption buffer on top of the committed pool for the first 30 days. This is operationally enforced by our quota plane; any consumption that exceeds the committed pool but stays within the buffer is billed at the same unit rates and will appear on the next invoice.
- Buffer authorization: by default the buffer is pre-approved for the first 30 days. If usage projects indicate likely exceedance of the buffer before day 20, Marissa (Finance) and Ellen (Customer) will get an automated notice and a one-click approval link to extend or increase the buffer.
- Credit trigger: if buffer consumption exceeds 80% of the buffer before day 30, we place a soft hold on additional burst capacity until explicit approval. This avoids runaway spend.

VAT / evidence:
- Please upload a VAT registration certificate (EU subsidiary) to the Drive link we shared; once we validate it we will mark all pilot invoices as VAT-pass-through. If you'd prefer Redwood to invoice the parent entity, we can add gross-up, but that requires different billing setup.

Attachments: I attached a redwood invoice template and an MOU stub for signature.

Next steps: if this works, we'll prepare the SOW addendum and a short MOU for signature — aiming for PO and first invoice to land by 6/18 to keep the kickoff week of 7/6.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen@novahealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-06-09T08:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Q3 pilot — payment cadence & VAT evidence

Ellen / Team — quick notes from Finance side.

Sound approach. A couple of operational clarifications:
- We'll accept Net30 for both invoices. For EU VAT pass-through we need the EU_VAT_certificate_novahealth.pdf ahead of invoice run for tax tagging.
- The contingent buffer will be tracked as an off-invoice credit bucket (line item: "contingent cap") on the first invoice so both parties see the cap and its starting balance. Usage drawing the buffer will decrement the bucket; we reconcile on the second invoice.
- If buffer usage triggers the 80% alert, we'll automatically block further burst requests after an internal 2-hour grace window unless procurement authorizes. Authorization can be the PO amendment or a quick email with the PO number — whichever NovaHealth prefers.

I attached the invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.xlsx) so your team can see how the contingent cap will appear. We'll also accept an e-signed addendum in place of a full amendment to move faster.

If everything above is OK, please countersign the MOU and confirm preferred PO cadence so we can schedule invoice dates.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen@novahealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-10T13:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Q3 pilot — payment cadence & VAT evidence

Looping in legal/ops notes. Two small items:
1) PO language: Please ensure PO references the SOW version and includes the wording: "Pilot services and reserved capacity as defined in SOW v1.2; payment tranches per MOU." That keeps invoicing aligned.
2) Data residency/tax holdback: If NovaHealth requires VAT withhold on payment to comply with local rules, we can include a one-line tax holdback process: Redwood will issue invoice gross, and the customer will remit net and include withholding certificate. We will credit/reconcile upon submission of that certificate per local rules.

I'll prepare a one-page addendum capturing the buffer behavior and authorization flow; will share by end of day 6/11.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel & Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Q3 pilot — payment cadence & VAT evidence

Thanks — this looks good and pragmatic. We uploaded the EU VAT cert to the shared Drive and countersigned the MOU (attached: NovaHealth_MOU_signed.pdf). Procurement will issue PO NH-2026-07 referencing SOW v1.2 and the MOU.

A couple of confirmations:
- PO issuance planned for 6/17; first invoice expected after PO is in our system (Net30).
- We accept the contingent buffer mechanics and the 80% soft hold; procurement prefers email authorization with PO number to extend buffer.
- We will follow the tax holdback route if local guidance requires, and will submit any withholding certificates within 10 business days of payment.

Please issue the initial invoice and MOU countersigned copy to procurement@novahealth.com and finance@novahealth.com. We'll be live for kickoff week of 7/6 once PO clears.

Best,
Ellen

Head of Data Platforms, NovaHealth
